questions: Is the double vision constant or does it come and go?
Do you have any weakness in your face, arms, or legs?
Are you having any trouble with balance or walking?
Do you have any pain in or around your eyes?
Have you recently had any head injury or infection?
Do you have high blood pressure or diabetes?
orders: Bedside neurological examination including fundoscopy and assessment of all cranial nerves
Cerebellar signs assessment including heel-shin test and finger-to-nose test
MRI of the internal auditory canals
Blood tests including CBC, glucose, HbA1c, TSH, and vitamin B12 levels
Lumbar puncture with opening pressure and CSF analysis
